scientific_integrity.claim: Exact finite geometric and arithmetic orbit census for conic-free points in PG(2,F64) over F2.
limitations: Only n=2,d=2 over F2; no all-dimensional binary generalization.
Counts require exact exhaustive finite verification; they are finite claims, not asymptotic deductions.
Unindexed classical finite-geometry coverage remains possible.
scientific_integrity.method: Symbolic witness plus independent binary rank/conic tests and exhaustive finite group orbit enumeration.

title: Eight projective orbit classes of conic-free points over \(\mathbb F_{64}\)
